summary: This clinical trial will test a 12-week app-based strength training program called PLAN-RT 1.0 for midlife women taking GLP-1 medications for weight loss. Researchers want to see if participants can successfully follow the digital exercise program and stick with the routine. The status of this study is Not yet recruiting. Louisiana State University and A&M College is sponsoring the trial, which aims to enroll 15 participants.

facts.sponsor: Louisiana State University and A&M College
